text.content:
Homebrew weapon property runes in use in the Seven Dooms for Sandpoint game. None of these exist in the PF2e system's rune list — etch one by renaming the weapon (+1 striking reeling longsword) and, where noted, adding a rule element to the weapon's Rules tab.

They're sold as runestones at the Sandpoint Boutique. A runestone costs the rune's Price plus 3 gp for the stone, and cracks when the rune is transferred.

RuneItemPriceRarityEffect
Wedging355 gpCommonWhen you Strike an unattended object or a structure with this weapon, ignore up to 5 Hardness. You also gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Force Open using the weapon.
Tolling470 gpCommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, the target is deafened until the end of your next turn. This is an auditory effect.
Guarding475 gpCommonThe weapon gains the parry trait. If the weapon already has the parry trait, the circumstance bonus it grants increases to +2.
Waltzing475 gpUncommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, you can Step as a free action.
Reeling4100 gpUncommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, the target is off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.
Shrouded5140 gpUncommonWhile the weapon is sheathed or stowed, it registers as nonmagical to detect magic and reads as an ordinary item of its kind to Perception checks. Drawing the weapon makes no sound.
Addling5150 gpUncommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, the target is stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn.
Greater Reeling6225 gpUncommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, the target is off-guard until the end of your next turn.
Sectioned6250 gpUncommonActivate—Unfold 1 Interact. The weapon separates into linked segments joined by fine chain. While unfolded it gains the reach trait, but you take a −2 circumstance penalty to Strikes against adjacent creatures. When you critically hit with the unfolded weapon, the target takes 1d4 persistent bleed damage. Refolding is another Interact action.
Stilling7350 gpUncommonWhen you critically hit with this weapon, the target can't use reactions until the end of your next turn.
Truing7360 gpUncommonActivate F envision (fortune); Frequency once per day. You reroll the triggering Strike's attack roll and use the new result.

Family

Reeling (Item 4) and greater reeling (Item 6) are one family: the lesser makes the target off-guard to you alone, the greater to everyone. Upgrade for the difference in Price, 125 gp.

Off-guard has no degrees — if the target is already off-guard from flanking, neither rune adds anything. They're at their best for a character fighting alone at the front.

Automation

Most of these are a Note rule element on the weapon, selector {item|_id}-damage, outcome criticalSuccess, which prints the rider in the damage card. Guarding uses AdjustStrike (property weapon-traits, value parry). Wedging, Shrouded, and Truing are GM adjudication.

Sectioned is automated by this module: use the Sectioned: Unfold / Refold macro, or drag Effect: Sectioned (Unfolded) onto the character. The effect asks which weapon it applies to, then handles the reach trait, the adjacent-target penalty, and the persistent bleed on a critical hit.
